name: observe
description: Read current RGB, measured TCP positions, pitch/roll/yaw degrees relative to the downward reference, permissions and budgets without advancing physics. Display floats use at most three decimal places.

name: vla_propose
description: Predict without moving. Give one short English immediate action naming the observed object and destination when needed; omit reasoning, code and multi-step plans. Return proposal_id and preview at steps 5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50 only. Each arm has pos_m (TCP XYZ), angles_deg ([pitch about +X, roll about +Y, yaw about +Z] from downward), grip (0 closed, 1 open), and measured-start prefix diagnostics: delta_cm, path_cm, max_step_cm, max_rotation_step_deg, max_joint_step_rad, grip_delta and grip_range (including start). Row bounds are cumulative existing warnings through that step. Statistics include every original step in the prefix. Read with RGB; predictions do not establish grasp or safety. No full 50-point inspection. A new proposal replaces the old one; act uses its stored original joint prefix.

name: act
description: Accept stored original VLA joint steps, or track model-supplied TCP targets with internal measured-state feedback and IK. TCP targets use continuous gripper_opening (0 closed, 1 open). Supplying targets declines the proposal. Check measured gripper openings every native step; a change of at least 0.02 after settling under a steady command interrupts with gripper_change_reobserve and gripper_event. Return status, actual native steps, residual errors, current RGB and measured TCP state. Inspect interrupted results before choosing another action; opening changes do not prove object loss. Pose arrival does not verify grasp. Keep reason/assessment concise.

proposal_id.description: Copy the current short VLA proposal_id, e.g. p1; omit when supplying targets.

steps.description: Consecutive prefix length; VLA allows 5..50, default 5.

position.description: Absolute gripping-face-centre TCP XYZ in environment-origin metres.

pitch_deg.description: Degrees about environment +X, relative to the downward reference.

roll_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Y, applied after pitch.

yaw_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Z, applied after roll.

gripper_opening.description: Continuous normalized opening: 0 fully closed, 1 fully open.

position.description: Absolute gripping-face-centre TCP XYZ in environment-origin metres.

pitch_deg.description: Degrees about environment +X, relative to the downward reference.

roll_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Y, applied after pitch.

yaw_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Z, applied after roll.

gripper_opening.description: Continuous normalized opening: 0 fully closed, 1 fully open.

targets.description: Model-chosen dual-arm TCP waypoints; no proposal_id or reject flag. Harness tracks each to 3mm/3deg before advancing. A waypoint may consume multiple native steps; model-side interpolation is unnecessary.

max_native_steps.description: Shared native-step budget for TCP tracking, default 80. Omit for original VLA acceptance.

review.description: Evidence at a required checkpoint. Without proposal_id/steps/targets, records the due review without motion.

name: hold_current
description: Calculate one full dual-arm TCP target from the latest measured state, preserving both poses and gripper openings. Read-only: no motion, VLA call, physics step or proposal replacement. Returns control_step, computed_only and targets; inspect them, then call act with targets to execute. Recalculate after any intervening action.

name: close_in_place
description: Calculate one full dual-arm TCP target from the latest measured state. Keep both poses and the other gripper unchanged; set the selected arm's opening (default 0, fully closed). Read-only; does not close or verify grasp. Returns control_step, computed_only and targets; inspect them, then call act with targets. Recalculate after any intervening action.

opening.description: Selected gripper's target opening, 0 closed and 1 open.

name: move_relative
description: Calculate one full dual-arm TCP target from the latest measured state. Add delta_m to the selected arm's TCP XYZ in environment axes; preserve both orientations, gripper openings and the other arm. Read-only; no motion or collision planning. Returns control_step, computed_only and targets; inspect them, then call act with targets. Recalculate after any intervening action.

delta_m.description: Environment-frame XYZ offsets in metres, not tool-local axes.
